prose: Mirendil, an AI startup founded by former Anthropic researchers to build self-improving AI, is in talks to raise roughly $1 billion led by Kleiner Perkins at a $5 billion valuation, Bloomberg reports.
highlights: Mirendil is in talks to raise ~$1B led by Kleiner Perkins.
The round would value the company at $5B.
Mirendil was founded by former Anthropic researchers to build self-improving AI.
